title: Negating configuration output
statement: Given a configuration of a machine with $k+1$ work tapes, Boolean work-tape symbols, a state set $S$, and a fixed Boolean input string $x$, form a configuration with the same state, input-head position, work-tape contents, and work-tape head positions, but replace every bit in the output string by its Boolean negation.
